You have five companies defense troops, a couple of flights of Speeders at your disposal&mdash;followed by whatever else we can scrape together."''<br />''"Roger that. Five companies, two flights. That's not much to hold off an Assault Group&hellip;"''<br />''"That's all we have, Colonel Firest&hellip;and Ledick&mdash;it's all or nothing this time.|Colonel Ledick Firest and General Carlist Rieekan|<ref name="AoH" />}}
The '''Ground Defense Forces''' was the name given to the military units under the command of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Ledick Firest/Legends|Ledick Firest]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. Consisting of five [[Company/Legends|companies]] of defense [[Soldier/Legends|troops]] and two [[Flight/Legends|flights]] of [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeders]], the Ground Defense Forces were tasked with [[Evac Rearguard Action 101|holding off]] the approaching [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]] and [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtroopers]] of [[Blizzard Force/Legends|Blizzard Force]].<ref name="AoH" />
